title: ServiceConfigResponse
description:
The service configuration for the Asset Management API.

The values in `limits` and `urls` are dynamic and can change without notice. Sync them every 5 minutes rather than hard-coding them into your device management service.

errorCodes.description: The set of possible error numbers and their human-readable explanations.

limits.description: The set of current request limits.

notificationTypes.description: The set of supported notification types.

urls.description: The set of current service URLs.
